sections.title: Real-time points ledger with idempotent reconciliation

fields.label: Scope
fields.body: Build a real-time ledger service that credits/debits loyalty points on purchase and refund events, with exactly-once processing across duplicate webhook deliveries.

fields.label: Story points
fields.body: 13 - large feature, multiple services, significant unknowns.

fields.label: Rationale
fields.body: New event-sourced ledger pattern, external dependency on the payments webhook provider's delivery guarantees.

sections.title: Loyalty tier badge on user profile page

fields.label: Scope
fields.body: Display the user's current loyalty tier as a badge on the existing profile page.

fields.label: Rationale
fields.body: Pure frontend display change against an already-exposed field.
